key_business_findings: HEALTHY PERFORMANCE — THD / DS leads Sales at $72,258.33 (50.8%), has the highest Actual CM at 22.01%, and its known operating burden rate is 16.63%.

Walmart / MP is the clearest operating anomaly: it has the lowest Sales at $11,795.16, the weakest Actual CM at -38.85%, the highest TACOS at 12.48%, and the highest known burden rate at 85.08%. These are concurrent pressures, not proof that market spend alone caused the CM result.

Lowe's / DS has the second-highest Sales at $39,784.14 and Actual CM 12.72%; its Return & Warranty Cost Rate is 14.25%, a notable contributor to current operating pressure relative to the other supported channels.

Walmart / DSV combines $18,398.22 of Sales with Actual CM 29.57%, zero TACOS, no Funding, and the lowest known burden rate at 1.00%; it is the clearest relative opportunity for further commercial review.
No supported core channel reports Funding in the current MTD management summary.
The largest negative CM gap remains Walmart / MP at -42.96 pp; the largest positive gap remains Walmart / DSV at 23.40 pp.

weekly_takeaways: Common sell-in sales were $142,235.85 on 983 units through 2026-08-17.
THD / DS led sell-in sales at $72,258.33 (50.8%); overview Actual CM was 22.01% versus BP 6.78% (15.22 pp).
Walmart / MP had the largest negative channel CM gap at -42.96 pp (Actual -38.85%; BP 4.11%), while contributing 8.3% of current sell-in sales.
Walmart / DSV had the largest positive channel CM gap at 23.40 pp (Actual 29.57%; BP 6.17%).
Badger contributed 93.2% of approved-core sell-in sales; the overview US brand summary reported Actual CM 24.52% versus BP -1.01% (25.53 pp).
THD DFC August MTD consumer sell-out was $37,978.21 on 50 units; recent 7D GMV was $16,864.81 versus $14,533.37 (16.0%), and remains outside Common Sales and CM.
